visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a bright orange long-sleeved sweater pushes a white toy garbage truck across a light-gray tiled floor. A Goofy plush toy is wedged into the back of the truck, which is filled with colorful paper cards. A translucent plastic container filled with crumpled paper and Lego blocks sits in the foreground. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting an indoor home or studio setting. (2) The person's hand reaches down and grabs the Goofy plush and the truck bed, shaking them vigorously and rhythmically up and down over the trash container. The camera is static, maintaining a medium close-up shot of the toy and the hand's motion. The Goofy toy's head bobbles significantly during the shaking. (3) The shaking motion continues with high intensity as the hand moves the toy slightly across the frame. The tiled floor provides a grid-like background. The visual focus remains entirely on the repetitive mechanical movement of the toy being 'sick' or 'nagged' over the trash bin.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A familiar upbeat synthesized BGM starts, mimicking the melody of Taiwan's garbage trucks. A male voice speaks in Mandarin with a clear, instructional tone, accompanied by the high-pitched friction sound of toy wheels rolling on a hard surface. (2) A series of rhythmic, staccato vocal sound effects begin, sounding like 'hyuck' or gagging noises, synchronized perfectly with the visual shaking of the toy. The BGM remains steady in the background. The vocal energy is high, creating a comedic effect through repetition and synchronized timing. (3) The rhythmic gagging sounds continue at a constant tempo, layered over the looping BGM. The sound of plastic parts clattering against each other adds a mechanical texture. The recording quality is clear with minimal background interference, emphasizing the exaggerated vocal performance until the track abruptly ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous parody of the common experience of taking out the trash in Taiwan. The video uses the iconic garbage truck melody and synchronizes exaggerated 'vomiting' or 'gagging' sounds to a toy truck, turning a mundane daily chore into a comedic meme.
